verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair thing to ask of a search API service, so the axis applies. The evidence shows an official MCP server, agent skills that run inside third-party tools such as Claude Code and Gemini CLI, curl examples and a browser playground, but nothing documents a first-party Brave Search CLI. These are adjacent integrations or other stories' capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
